messages:
Tori L.: opened a tiny PR to clarify trace-cost wording and swap a dashboard CSV example to use `trace_id` and the kv helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233 :wave:
Ben K.: quick skim  one Node snippet still uses `traceId` camelCase, please change to `trace_id` to match dashboards.
Akira S.: will patch that and also update the example that used `tracing.enable()` -> `tracing.startSpan()` (note: requires SDK >= 2.3).
Tori L.: can we add a small anchor next to the cost table: id="trace-cost-map" so PMs can link directly? one short line under the table about sequence length affecting per-token cost would help.
Ben K.: added the anchor and the sentence: "Shorter average sequences often improve batching and lower per-token cost." kept non-technical.
Akira S.: pushed snippet fixes and swapped kv example from manual key composition to `kv.setForSession(sessionId, payload)`. split into two commits.
buildbot: docs CI passed for PR #5233 (build 5019) :white_check_mark:
Tori L.: thanks everyone  final plan: squash lintbot commit and merge after approvals. tagging #product-docs for visibility :sparkles:
__notes: small docs PR coordination: trace_id standardization, SDK call update, kv helper swap, anchor addition, sequence-length note, CI pass.
